name: @movie-desk/desktop
description: Movie Desk — a local-first AI video editor that organizes footage and creates a first cut.
author: Movie Desk contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,electron -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @movie-desk/web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000/editor && MOVIE_DESK_DEV_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @movie-desk/web prebundle:models && pnpm --filter @movie-desk/web exec cross-env NEXT_OUTPUT=export next build
